Bak Kut Teh Pai Kut.note: Pork. Soy sauce = soy + gluten. Tofu puffs = soy. Dang gui (angelica) is not celery. Herbal, not spicy.

Bak Kut Teh Sam Chan.note: Pork belly; soy sauce, tofu puffs.

Bak Kut Teh Mixed.note: Pork cuts and stomach; soy sauce, tofu puffs.

Bak Kut Teh Intestine.note: Pork intestine; soy sauce, tofu puffs.

Dry Bak Kut Teh.note: Dried cuttlefish = molluscs; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten (g); Shaoxing = sulphites + gluten, not halal; dark soy. Mildly spicy = 1.

Pork Trotter in Black Vinegar.note: Black vinegar with wheat bran = gluten (v7 Chinkiang ruling); dark soy; hard-boiled egg. Sold out in extra.json.

Herbal Chicken Soup.note: Light soy sauce = soy + gluten. No pork, no alcohol, own pot: halal from ingredients (v6/v7 convention) in a kitchen whose branch halal status is none; no case requires it for a Muslim guest.

Set Pai Kut.note: Pai Kut soup (soy sauce); yam rice has dried shrimp = crustaceans and pork lard; yau char kwai = wheat.

Set Dry Bak Kut Teh.note: As Dry Bak Kut Teh, plus plain rice and tea.

Set Herbal Chicken.note: As Herbal Chicken Soup, plus plain rice and tea.

Yam Rice.note: Dried shrimp = crustaceans; pork lard, so not vegetarian or halal; light soy = soy + gluten.

Yau Char Kwai.note: Wheat dough, stated egg-free, palm oil.

Braised Tofu Puff.note: Sounds vegetarian but is braised in pork broth. Tofu + soy sauce.

Braised Egg.note: Egg braised in pork broth with soy sauce.

Salted Vegetable.note: Kiam chye (preserved mustard greens) is not the mustard allergen (rule m). Pork fat: not vegetarian or halal. A little chilli = 1.

Garlic Lettuce.note: Oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten (g); lard oil: not vegetarian or halal.

Stir-fried Choy Sum.note: Garlic, salt, vegetable oil, stated no oyster sauce.

Kopi.note: Condensed milk. No butter roast stated.

Tsingtao Beer.note: Barley malt = gluten; alcohol, not halal.

Barley Fu Chuk.note: Pearl barley = gluten; beancurd skin = soy; beaten egg. Ginkgo is a seed, not a regulated tree nut.
